description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and identifies `nestedpdfmerger` as the required tool. 2. Agent runs `nestedpdfmerger /workspace/filings --dry-run --sort natural --reverse --exclude Archive Draft --exclude-hidden` to preview merge order. 3. Agent inspects dry-run output to confirm Q2_2024 appears before Q1_2024, and Section_10 before Section_9 within Q2. 4. Agent runs the final merge: `nestedpdfmerger /workspace/filings -o /workspace/quarterly_merged.pdf --sort natural --reverse --exclude Archive Draft --exclude-hidden`. Key proprietary traps: (a) `--exclude` takes space-separated directory NAMES not paths — `--exclude Archive Draft` not `--exclude=filings/Archive`; (b) `--sort natural` paired with `--reverse` is a bespoke combination not obvious from generic knowledge; (c) `--exclude-hidden` is a dedicated flag, not achieved through `--exclude`; (d) bookmarks are on by default so `--no-bookmarks` must NOT be used.
